name: doc-hero
purpose: The masthead of a documentation home: a display-size `h1`, a deck capped at a readable measure, an action row (the primary `Get started`, then `CopyPromptButton`) and one muted note under it that says what the prompt does. It carries the air the home needs — `--spacing-xxl` above and below, `--spacing-xl` between the deck and the actions — so the front door reads as a front door and not as one more article. An article page uses `DocPageHeader` instead.
useWhen: The top of a documentation home or a docs section landing (`shells/documentation`, variant `Landing`).
avoidWhen: On an article or reference page → use `DocPageHeader` (breadcrumb, last updated, page actions).
On the marketing site → use `Hero` or a page section.
related: CopyPromptButton` — the second action of the row.
DocAgentCard` — the agent card that usually opens the first section under the hero.
bestPractices: Keep the title short (`Welcome to Azion Docs`) and the deck to one or two sentences.
Put `Button kind="primary" size="large"` first and `CopyPromptButton` second in `#actions`; say what the prompt does in `#note`.
Do not wrap it in `DocProse`; it is page chrome (`data-doc-chrome`).

props.name: title
props.doc: The page title, set at display size as the page's `h1`.

props.name: description
props.doc: The deck under the title: what the docs cover, in one or two sentences.

slots.name: title
slots.notes: Replaces the title text, for a title that is more than a string.

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: The action row: the primary `Button` first, then `CopyPromptButton`.

slots.name: note
slots.notes: One muted line under the actions that says what the prompt does.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import CopyPromptButton from '@aziontech/webkit/copy-prompt-button'
  import DocHero from '@aziontech/webkit/doc-hero'

  const prompt =
    'Set up the Azion CLI, connect the Azion docs over MCP and link this project to my Azion account.'
</script>

<template>
  <DocHero
    title="Welcome to Azion Docs"
    description="We make every application fast and reliable. Deploy on a global network with enterprise-grade security and no cold starts."
  >
    <template #actions>
      <Button
        label="Get started"
        kind="primary"
        size="large"
        href="#"
      />
      <CopyPromptButton :value="prompt" />
    </template>
    <template #note>
      The prompt hands your coding agent the CLI, live docs over MCP, and this project linked.
    </template>
  </DocHero>
</template>
